referral.reason_text: Looser stools 2 months, 4kg weight loss, intermittent blood. Colonoscopy 5 months ago normal; please advise whether repeat is needed.

deciding.fast_track_met: FIT is pending with no value and there is no anaemia result. Weight loss and bleeding are documented but no listed criterion is confirmed, so false is favoured and true remains plausible.
deciding.vetting_outcome: Bleeding and 4kg weight loss in a 66-year-old point to expediting despite the normal colonoscopy 5 months ago. The pending FIT leaves some doubt.
deciding.first_contact: The reason text explicitly asks for advice on whether a repeat is needed, which fits a written answer.
deciding.clinical_urgency: Weight loss and bleeding are unexplained red flags (level 2). Pending results and possible repeat endoscopy keep level 3 plausible.
deciding.record_agreement: Sections agree on weight loss, age and the prior colonoscopy. There are no visible mismatches, but the ticked flags are not fully backed by results.
